strona_podtytul: Gluing, welding and construction of plastic structures
o_nas_opis: We specialize in professional services related to plastics processing. We offer repairs (gluing and welding) and the construction of specialized cuboid structures. Our repair method restores full functionality and does not change the original purpose of the element.
o_nas_tworzywa_skrot: We weld materials such as: PP, PELD, ABS, ASA, PEHD, TPO, PVC, PUR and many more.
o_nas_wstep: We repair cracks, fill missing material, replace missing mounts, and straighten deformations. The repair method does not change the original purpose and appearance of the element, but the welding spot remains visible.
o_nas_tworzywa_full: We weld plastics such as: PP, PELD, ABS, ASA, PEHD, TPO, PP/EPDM, POM, PC/PBT, PE, PS, PA, PA/ABS, PBT, PBT/ABS, PPO, PEIMD, PC/ABS, PP/PE, PC, PP/ET2X, PMMA (plexi), PPE/PA, PA+GF, PP+GF, PVC, PUR, and others.
o_nas_cena: You can send photos and a description of the damaged item via email for an estimated quote. After receiving the item for repair, the customer is informed of the final cost, and we proceed upon price acceptance.
o_nas_sekcja1_lista1: Repair of bumpers and spoilers: welding cracks, repairing and reconstructing various elements such as mounts etc., filling gaps, welding holes, and straightening deformations.
o_nas_sekcja1_lista2: Repair of mirror housings, lamps (broken mounts and housings), air filters, and engine covers.
o_nas_sekcja1_lista3: Welding of washer, coolant, power steering, and brake fluid tanks, as well as fans.
o_nas_sekcja1_lista4: Repair of broken fuel filler flaps and motorcycle fairings.
o_nas_sekcja2_lista1: Repair of garden equipment, including furniture, trash bins, containers, and lawnmower covers.
o_nas_sekcja2_lista2: Repair of excavator parts, machinery, and housings for tools and power tools.
o_nas_sekcja2_lista3: Repairing cracked suitcases and travel bags, replacing feet, and welding plastic parts of baby strollers.
o_nas_sekcja3_opis: We custom-build cuboid tanks for water, wastewater, and chemicals, tanks for agriculture and the food industry, composters, and galvanic tanks (up to 2000mm). Tank walls are built from PP-H and PEHD, ensuring high strength, chemical resistance, and temperature resistance from -20 to +80°C. Galvanic tanks are built strictly with plastic reinforcements, while standard cuboid tanks have aluminum beam reinforcements. We guarantee the strength and tightness for these services.
o_nas_sekcja4_opis: We produce fully weather-resistant acrylic (plexi) number plates and illuminated house number plafonds. All necessary mounting hardware is included.
